turns.content: In 2024, which month had the most Seattle building permit applications submitted? Answer as YYYY-MM.

content.thinking: About 46,262 records have no applied date, which is a big caveat. I'm weighing whether to check list_cities for the excluded entries across all time, but it isn't strictly needed. The answer is 2024-10, and I'll give it with that caveat.

content.text:
October 2024 had the most Seattle permit applications. I counted applications by the date they were submitted. Of the 6,064 permits with a 2024 application date, October had 619, well ahead of March with 552 and April with 526.

| Month | Applications |
|---|---|
| 2024-01 | 470 |
| 2024-02 | 454 |
| 2024-03 | 552 |
| 2024-04 | 526 |
| 2024-05 | 516 |
| 2024-06 | 458 |
| 2024-07 | 513 |
| 2024-08 | 489 |
| 2024-09 | 504 |
| **2024-10** | **619** |
| 2024-11 | 501 |
| 2024-12 | 462 |

One limit: 46,262 Seattle permits have no application date, so they can't be placed in any month. That count covers all years, not just 2024. If many of them were submitted in 2024, the monthly order could change, but the data can't show that.

FINAL ANSWER: 2024-10
